items.name: PartitionEvaluatorArgs
items.summary: Arguments passed to created user-defined window function state during physical execution.

methods.name: ignore_nulls
methods.summary: Returns `true` when `IGNORE NULLS` is specified, otherwise returns `false`.

methods.name: input_exprs
methods.summary: Returns the expressions passed as arguments to the user-defined window function.

methods.name: input_fields
methods.summary: Returns the [`FieldRef`]s corresponding to the input expressions to the user-defined window function.

methods.name: is_reversed
methods.summary: Returns `true` when the user-defined window function is reversed, otherwise returns `false`.
